blurb: Greystone Golf Club features a parkland course sculpted into the Niagara Escarpment with wide fairways, challenging greens, and significant elevation changes. The course opened in 1991 and includes a range, putting green, chipping area, and practice bunker. The Tudor-style clubhouse offers a venue for meetings, weddings, and dining.
extraNote: Tee times may be booked up to five days in advance and are subject to availability · Non-weather related tee time cancellations or modifications are required no less than 16 hours prior to play · A fee may apply for full or partial no-shows, or for cancellations made inside 16 hours from time of play · Non-compliance with tee time bookings may result in a $100 fee and further action · Dress code requires tasteful and respectful golf attire; denim is not allowed on the course
